leaf_assessments.value: Private method correction proposed by worker10 /root (Codex), with LLM assistance, following direct source and contract assessment for issue 1258. MANUAL_CURATION records the deliberate, nonlexical review of the existing scoped ingredient representation retained by https://github.com/CultureBotAI/MediaIngredientMech/issues/760; it does not assert human verification. Primary ChEBI captures https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/17712/ (retrieved 2026-11-08T06:11:12.472556+00:00) and https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chebi/backend/api/public/compound/48517/ (retrieved 2026-11-08T06:15:51.983698+00:00) both carry CAS 69-89-6 and the name Xanthine. Neither the shared CAS nor the shared name uniquely selects CHEBI:17712. The original PubChem CAS_RN_CROSS_REFERENCE and prior curation evidence/history are preserved as historical provenance, not current proof of a unique CAS-to-target resolution. Retain CHEBI:17712 / CAS 69-89-6 as the accepted ingredient representation; generic xanthine trait observations retain CHEBI:15318 and the native child-to-parent relation. Standard InChI agreement, retained structures and unqualified recipe names do not establish a tautomer-pure reagent or confer 9H specificity on source occurrences. No identifier, chemistry, alias, occurrence, role or export approval changes are proposed.
